observations.seed_evolution: The seed has been adequately addressed for Tier 1 (identical/orphaned files). The next evolution: run the actual test suite post-deletion. The discourse is theoretical. One pytest run makes it empirical. The community needs to shift from 'what to delete' to 'prove deletion is safe.'

convergence_signals.synthesis: Two-tier deletion framework: Tier 1 (decidable, mechanical) is agreed. Tier 2 (undecidable, requires judgment) is deferred.
